purpose: Semantic reference cases only. This is not a Construct 2 importer input format.

references.role: arcade gameplay, selection, OR/inversion, expressions and temporal semantics

expected_contract: Touch-start and Space-key press remain an OR condition group.
The Queda instance variable remains a boolean guard in the player instance scope.
Inversion is represented on the condition node and is evaluated with its selection effects.
Jump vector, angle and animation actions retain source order.
Wait becomes a non-blocking continuation; selected-instance and re-entry behavior are verified against C3.
dt is retained as a typed clock-domain expression, not replaced by render delta implicitly.
random argument order and RNG draw consumption are deterministic and traceable.
Every-X-seconds scheduling uses a project timer contract.
Created pipe instances receive their per-instance Scored default before scoring can observe them.
Object creation/destruction visibility follows declared structural-mutation boundaries.
Collision conditions expose the participating selected instances.
The Scored flag belongs to each BottomPipe instance, not the object type globally.
Score remains a global numeric variable.
Collision response actions retain declaration order.
External storage/audio operations declare capability and side-effect metadata.
Common in-game remains one resource shared by Chaves and Continuous events.
Include edges retain authored order and are not copied into consumer sheets.
Include cycles and missing referenced sheets produce import diagnostics.
Base object plugin and attached behavior definitions remain separate in the project model.
Behavior parameters and behavior ACEs resolve through the behavior registry.
Layout and Event Sheet identity is preserved across levels and menus.
The inventory is provisional until every object type and behavior declaration is checked.
